mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id as id, u.nickname, u.email, u.phone, u.bio, u.status_msg as status, s.plan_name as subscriptionName, p.available_points as points, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM counsel_sessions WHERE user_id = u.user_id) as totalSessions FROM users u LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON u.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN points p ON u.user_id = p.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT order_id as id, product_name as title, amount, paid_at as date, pay_method as method, order_status as status FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY paid_at DESC
